episodeTitle.en: Hard-won lessons building 0 to 1 inside Atlassian | Tanguy Crusson (Head of Jira Product Discovery)
episodeTitle.zh: 《在Atlassian内部从0到1的艰辛历程 | 坦古伊·克鲁松（Tanguy Crusson，Jira产品发现负责人）》

guestBioOfficial.en: Tanguy Crusson is the product lead for Jira Product Discovery at Atlassian. In his more than 10 years at the company, he has been instrumental in taking several new products from zero to one, including HipChat, Statuspage, and Jira Product Discovery. In this episode, we dive deep into the struggles of innovating and building new products inside a large company. Tanguy shares candid stories about what worked, what didn’t, and his many hard-won lessons learned about how to successfully build 0 to 1. We cover: • Why large companies with so many advantages still fail at creating new products
guestBioOfficial.zh: 坦吉·克鲁松（Tanguy Crusson）是Atlassian公司Jira产品探索部门的产品负责人。他在该公司的十余年间，成功推动了多款新产品从零到一的成长，包括HipChat、Statuspage和Jira Product Discovery。在本期节目中，我们将深入探讨大型企业内部创新和打造新产品的挑战。坦吉将分享真知灼见，讲述成功经验与失败教训，揭示如何从0到1成功打造新产品。我们将重点探讨：•为何拥有诸多优势的大型企业仍在新产品开发上屡屡碰壁

title.en: Hard-won lessons building 0 to 1 inside Atlassian | Tanguy Crusson (Head of Jira Product Discovery)
title.zh: 《在Atlassian内部从0到1的艰辛历程 | 坦古伊·克鲁松（Tanguy Crusson，Jira产品发现负责人）》

summary.en: Tanguy shares the real, unglamorous challenges of innovating and building zero-to-one inside a large company like Atlassian. He discusses why some internal big bets worked and others didn't, how to get coverage for ambitious ideas, and what he learned from products like HipChat and Jira Product Discovery. The episode is a candid look at corporate innovation from someone who has actually shipped it.
summary.zh: Tanguy 分享了在 Atlassian 这样的大公司内部推动创新、打造“从零到一”产品的真实且不易的难题。他讨论了为何有些内部大赌注成功了、有些却没有，如何为雄心勃勃的想法争取支持，以及从 HipChat 和 Jira Product Discovery 等产品中学到的东西。本期是一位真正交付过产品的人的、坦诚的企业创新透视。
